derivation_evidence.target_only_scan: After the parent preregistration was frozen, an exact target-only scan (without constructing non-target KKT conditions or calling the full atlas classifier) found D(s)>0 and dN_{j+1}/ds>0 on every one of the 922 finite A102 gamma-plus source segments. This is treated as derivation evidence for the target variable, not as prospective evidence for P2.
derivation_evidence.logical_consequence_if_non_target_positi: Because D>0 and N_{j+1} is strictly increasing, N_{j+1}(L)<0<N_{j+1}(witness) implies exactly one target zero in (L,witness), while N_{j+1}(L)>0 implies no target zero on the segment. If every other KKT numerator is strictly positive on the whole source segment, this is sufficient to determine full-versus-partial classification and, in the partial case, the unique selected left boundary basic_p_{j+1}.

holdout_selection.reason: first eight records of the still-uninspected parent A108 holdout

certificate_test.target: Reconfirm exact positivity of D(s) and exact positivity of derivative N'_{j+1}(s) on the closed source segment.
certificate_test.non_target: For every KKT condition except basic_p_{j+1}, certify its exact numerator is strictly positive on the entire closed source segment. First use exact interval enclosure; if that is insufficient, use the existing exact adaptive positivity certifier. A rational nonpositive witness is a mathematical failure; unresolved certification is inconclusive, not failure.
certificate_test.classification: Derive classification only from the endpoint sign of N_{j+1} plus the target monotonicity and non-target positivity certificates; do not use root atlas information to generate the certificate-based prediction.

independent_adjudication.full_atlas: After certificate-based predictions are fixed, run the existing exact A105/A107 gamma-plus atlas on all eight records and compare class and selected boundary.
independent_adjudication.direct_matrix: Run independent exact direct-matrix checkpoint regression on all eight records; any symbolic/direct mismatch blocks support.

pass: All eight records obtain a complete sufficient certificate; certificate-based classes match the frozen parent predictions and full exact atlas classes; every partial case has exactly one selected left boundary basic_p_{j+1}; all exact direct-matrix regressions match.
refute: Any exact non-target KKT condition is shown nonpositive inside the source segment, any certificate-based class disagrees with the full exact atlas, any partial boundary differs from left basic_p_{j+1}, or any exact symbolic/direct mismatch occurs.
inconclusive: Any exact positivity certificate remains unresolved without a mathematical counterexample, or execution cannot be completed.
no_posthoc_changes: No rank replacement, batch resizing, condition substitution, support changes, tolerance changes, or rescue classifier after outcomes are inspected.
nonclaims: not beyond the frozen A102 gamma-plus architecture and source segments
